summary.motive: Combine gap-scheme power blocking with a read of the backside end so the defense must defend both the pull and the keep.
summary.whyItWorks: The pull is irresistible bait for the end, and once he chases it the wrap blocker owns the second level while the kick-out has already collapsed the edge.
summary.failureMode: The end stays home and squeezes the pull instead, forcing the quarterback to pull the ball into an unblocked C-gap with nowhere to go.

beats.title: 1. The Pull and the Read
beats.text: The guard kicks flat toward the edge while the quarterback seats the pistol mesh with eyes locked on the unblocked backside end.

beats.title: 2. The End Chases the Puller
beats.text: The end bites on the pull and sprints inside chasing it. His edge is gone, so the give branch is declared before the ball even arrives.

beats.title: 3. Kick-Out and Wrap
beats.text: The guard logs the playside end inside while the wrapping tackle rises into the hole hunting the Mike linebacker.

beats.title: 4. Off-Tackle Behind the Leader
beats.text: The back presses off-tackle behind the wrap block, turning upfield through a seam where both second-level defenders have been displaced.

relations.tell: A guard pulls while the quarterback still reads a defender — pure power-o hands the ball immediately with no ride phase.
